methodology: All 18 slides were rendered at a consistent size and sampled at 320 × 180 pixels per slide. The combined field was quantized, then reduced to recurring presentation roles so photographic one-offs did not displace the deck's repeated borders, panels, cards, wallpaper, and cool counterpoints.
summary: The deck intensifies the existing oxblood-and-copper base into a warmer storybook system: saturated red and orange carry the structure, faded rose and cream soften it, and midnight blue, plum, and aged teal keep the result from becoming uniformly warm.
